name: 32603 · Gainesville, FL
findings: ZIP 32603 (Gainesville) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32603 (Gainesville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32603 (Gainesville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
